questions.text: Do you have a job, or are you studying?

questions.text: Describe a song or piece of music that is special to you.
questions.say: Thank you. Now, in Part 2, I'm going to give you a topic, and I'd like you to talk about it for one to two minutes. Before you talk, you'll have one minute to think about what you're going to say. You can make some notes if you wish. Here is your topic. Describe a song or piece of music that is special to you. You should say: what it is; when you first heard it; how often you listen to it; and explain why it is special to you.

questions.text: Do your friends like this song or piece of music too?
questions.say: Thank you. Do your friends like this song or piece of music too?

questions.text: Why do people often like the music they listened to when they were young?
questions.say: Thank you. We've been talking about a song or piece of music that is special to you, and I'd like to discuss with you some more general questions related to this. Let's consider first of all music in people's lives. Why do people often like the music they listened to when they were young?

questions.text: How can music affect people's moods?
questions.say: How can music affect people's moods?

questions.text: Should all children learn to play a musical instrument?

questions.text: How has the internet changed the music industry?

questions.text: Is it fair that musicians earn very little from online music services?
